sql.query: SELECT mergeData.templateId,mergeData.workflowId,mergeData.templateName,mergeData.workflowName,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(mergeData.bodyHtml,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.workflowName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.reference',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.referenceCode),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.showDate',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.showDate),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'event.showTime',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.showTime),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'location.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.locationName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'space.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.spaceName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'configuration.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.configurationName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'tenant.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.tenantName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'owner.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.ownerName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contact.name',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.contactName),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contact.email',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),mergeData.contactEmail) renderedHtml FROM (SELECT ct.id templateId,w.id workflowId,ct.templateName,ct.bodyHtml,COALESCE(w.workflowName,'') workflowName,COALESCE(w.referenceCode,'') referenceCode,COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT((SELECT COALESCE(fv.valueDate,w.targetDate) FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.fieldKey='show_date' LIMIT 1),'%d %M %Y'),DATE_FORMAT(w.targetDate,'%d %M %Y'),'') showDate,COALESCE((SELECT NULLIF(fv.valueText,'') FROM tbl_workflow_field_values fv WHERE fv.workflowId=w.id AND fv.tenantId=w.tenantId AND fv.fieldKey='show_time' LIMIT 1),'') showTime,COALESCE(l.locationName,'') locationName,COALESCE(s.spaceName,'') spaceName,COALESCE(c.configurationName,'') configurationName,COALESCE(t.tenantName,'') tenantName,COALESCE(u.displayName,team.teamName,'') ownerName,COALESCE((SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',contact.firstName,contact.lastName)),''),contact.displayName,contact.organisationName,'') FROM tbl_workflow_contacts wc INNER JOIN tbl_contacts contact ON contact.id=wc.contactId AND contact.tenantId=wc.tenantId WHERE wc.workflowId=w.id AND wc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY wc.isPrimary DESC,wc.id LIMIT 1),'') contactName,COALESCE((SELECT contact.email FROM tbl_workflow_contacts wc INNER JOIN tbl_contacts contact ON contact.id=wc.contactId AND contact.tenantId=wc.tenantId WHERE wc.workflowId=w.id AND wc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY wc.isPrimary DESC,wc.id LIMIT 1),'') contactEmail FROM tbl_contract_templates ct INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=ct.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_locations l ON l.id=w.locationId AND l.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_spaces s ON s.id=w.spaceId AND s.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_space_configurations c ON c.id=w.configurationId AND c.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=w.ownerUserId LEFT JOIN tbl_teams team ON team.id=w.ownerTeamId AND team.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE ct.id=:templateId AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND ct.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.create' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1) mergeData

SELECT :templateId templateId,:workflowId workflowId,:templateName templateName,:workflowName workflowName,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(:baseHtml,CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.legalName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.legalName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.tradingName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.tradingName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.registrationNumber',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.registrationNumber,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.vatNumber',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.vatNumber,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.registeredAddress',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(', ',ce.addressLine1,ce.addressLine2,ce.townCity,ce.countyRegion,ce.postcode,ce.country),'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.signatoryName',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.signatoryName,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.signatoryTitle',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.signatoryTitle,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.paymentTerms',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.defaultPaymentTerms,'')),CONCAT(CHAR(123),CHAR(123),'contractingEntity.footer',CHAR(125),CHAR(125)),COALESCE(ce.contractFooter,'')) renderedHtml FROM tbl_workflows w LEFT JOIN tbl_contracting_entities ce ON ce.id=COALESCE(w.contractingEntityId,(SELECT d.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities d WHERE d.tenantId=w.tenantId AND d.isDefault=1 AND d.isActive=1 LIMIT 1)) AND ce.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE w.id=:workflowId2 AND w.tenantId=:tenantId LIMIT 1
